title: Juice Preference in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: ED patients who are able to drink juice will be approached and asked their beverage preference.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All Emergency Department patients, of any age, who are cleared by their treating physician to drink juice, and are able to communicate a juice preference. Patients are only enrolled during randomly selected 1-hour blocks once per week for 26 weeks.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previously enrolled in the study
* Patients who are placed in the "special care" unit of the Emergency Department, which generally cares for intoxicated patients.
study_population: All Emergency Department patients, of any age, who are cleared by their treating physician to drink juice, and are able to communicate a juice preference.
condition: All Eligible ED Patients (Not Limited to a Particular Condition)
